# Code of conduct

Be kind, assume good faith, and keep it about the work. That goes for issues, pull requests, reviews, and anywhere else this project is the reason you are talking.

Not here:

- Harassment, insults, or personal attacks, of anyone, for anything.
- Unwelcome sexual attention or imagery.
- Posting someone's private details without their consent.

The maintainer, [@saworbit](https://github.com/saworbit), may edit or remove comments, lock threads, and block anyone who will not stop. To report something privately, email the address on that GitHub profile. Reports are kept confidential.
